schemes.scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.short_description: Central scholarship support for eligible college and university students across India.
schemes.description: Implemented by the Ministry of Education through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
schemes.income_requirements: Family annual income up to Rs 4.5 Lakh per annum

benefits.description: Scholarship of Rs 12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first 3 years and Rs 20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level.

conditions.description: Applicant must be in the top 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12 board exams.
Gross annual family income must not exceed Rs 4.5 Lakh per annum.
Pursuing regular courses (not correspondence or distance mode) in recognized colleges/universities.
Not receiving any other government scholarship or fee reimbursement.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate issued by competent authority
Proof of Admission / Bonafide Student Certificate

application_process.description: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) using OTR/Aadhaar.
Fill the application form for Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship.
Upload scanned copies of required documents including income certificate and marksheet.
Submit form online for institute-level electronic verification.
Upon state nodal officer approval, scholarship is disbursed directly to applicant bank account via DBT.

faqs.question: Can distance education students apply?
faqs.answer: No, only regular students pursuing full-time degree courses in recognized colleges are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the maximum income limit?
faqs.answer: The annual family income limit is Rs 4.5 Lakh per annum.

schemes.short_description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families across India.
schemes.description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring agricultural inputs and domestic needs.
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.income_requirements: Farmer families with cultivable landholding (excluding income-tax payers and high economic status holders)

benefits.description: Financial benefit of Rs 6,000 per year payable in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 every four months.

conditions.description: Farmer family owning cultivable land registered in state land records.
Must complete e-KYC via Aadhaar-linked OTP or biometric verification.
Institutional landholders, serving/retired government officers, and income tax payers in last assessment year are excluded.

application_process.description: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'Farmers Corner' -> 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar number, state, land details, and bank account information.
Application verified electronically by local revenue officer / Nodal Officer.
Installments credited directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.question: How much financial support is provided?
faqs.answer: Rs 6,000 per year transferred in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000 each.

faqs.question: Is e-KYC compulsory?
faqs.answer: Yes, e-KYC is mandatory for receiving PM-KISAN installments.

schemes.short_description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl children with high interest rate and tax benefits.
schemes.description: Launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana encourages parents to build a fund for the future education and marriage expenses of their female child.
schemes.department: Department of Posts / Department of Economic Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Girl Child (up to 10 years of age)
schemes.age_requirements: Below 10 years of age at the time of account opening

benefits.description: High interest rate (8.2% per annum compounded annually) with tax exemption under Section 80C and triple-tax-free status (EEE).

root.description: Eligibility conditions for Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana.

conditions.description: Account can be opened by natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child from birth till age of 10 years.
Only one account per girl child, and maximum 2 girl children per family (exceptions for twins/triplets).
Minimum deposit Rs 250 and maximum Rs 1.5 Lakh in a financial year.

required_documents.name: Identity Proof of Parent/Guardian (Aadhaar / PAN Card)
Passport size photographs of child and guardian

application_process.description: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized public/private sector commercial bank.
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form.
Submit filled form along with birth certificate of girl child and guardian KYC documents.
Deposit initial amount (minimum Rs 250) via cash, cheque, or demand draft.
Bank/Post Office issues account passbook recording deposits and interest.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for girl child?
faqs.answer: Account must be opened before the girl child attains 10 years of age.

faqs.question: When does the account mature?
faqs.answer: Matures after 21 years from account opening or upon marriage after age 18.

schemes.short_description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 Lakh for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
schemes.description: PMMY provides institutional micro-credit to small business entrepreneurs for income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading, service sectors, and agriculture-allied activities across Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Micro Entrepreneurs, Small Business Owners, Street Vendors, Artisans
schemes.income_requirements: No prior income threshold; creditworthiness for business proposal

benefits.description: Collateral-free business loan: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 Lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 Lakh to Rs 10 Lakh), Tarun Plus (up to Rs 20 Lakh for previous successful repayment).

conditions.description: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for non-farm income-generating activity.
Must not be a defaulter to any financial institution/bank.
Loan extended through Banks, NBFCs, and MFIs without requirement of collateral security.

required_documents.name: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Business Plan / Project Proposal / Quotation for machinery
Proof of Business Identity / Registration (GST / Udyam Certificate if available)

application_process.description: Visit jansamarth.in or approach commercial bank / RRB / MFI.
Select MUDRA category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun) and fill JanSamarth application.
Enter proposed business activity, loan requirement, and upload identity/address proof.
Bank reviews business feasibility and credit check.
Loan sanctioned and MUDRA Card issued for working capital withdrawals.

faqs.question: Is collateral needed for MUDRA loan?
faqs.answer: No collateral is required for MUDRA loans.

faqs.question: What are the loan limits?
faqs.answer: Shishu: up to Rs 50k; Kishore: Rs 50k-5L; Tarun: Rs 5L-10L; Tarun Plus: up to Rs 20L.

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.short_description: Health insurance cover of Rs 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
schemes.description: PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides cashless and paperless access to healthcare services for poor and vulnerable families across empanelled public and private hospitals in India.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Poor and Vulnerable Families, Senior Citizens aged 70+
schemes.age_requirements: All ages (Special Universal Cover for Senior Citizens aged 70 and above)
schemes.income_requirements: Families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card holders
schemes.occupation_requirements: Informal Workers, Daily Wagers, Rural Poor, Urban Occupational Categories

benefits.description: Cashless health cover up to Rs 500,000 per family per year for 1,900+ medical procedures across empanelled hospitals.

root.description: Eligibility criteria for Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.

conditions.description: Families listed in SECC 2011 database or RSBY cardholders.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above (irrespective of income) under Ayushman Vaya Vandana.
No restriction on family size or age of members.

application_process.description: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or Ayushman App.
Perform self-eKYC using Aadhaar OTP or facial authentication.
Upon approval, download the digital Ayushman Card.
Present Ayushman Card at empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

faqs.question: How much health cover is provided?
faqs.answer: Rs 5 Lakh per family per year for hospitalization.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing diseases covered?
faqs.answer: Yes, all pre-existing medical conditions are covered from Day 1.

schemes.short_description: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 for unorganized sector workers.
schemes.description: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme targeted at unorganized sector workers to provide financial security in old age with guaranteed minimum monthly pension options.

benefits.description: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000, Rs 2,000, Rs 3,000, Rs 4,000, or Rs 5,000 starting at age 60, followed by spouse pension and corpus payout to nominee.

conditions.description: Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years.
Must have a savings bank account linked with mobile and Aadhaar.
Must not be an income tax payer.

required_documents.name: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account details

application_process.description: Approach bank branch where savings account is maintained or log into net banking.
Fill APY registration form specifying pension choice (Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000).
Provide auto-debit consent for monthly/quarterly premium deduction.
PFRDA generates Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN).

faqs.question: What is the entry age?
faqs.answer: Citizen must be between 18 and 40 years old.

faqs.question: Can income tax payers join?
faqs.answer: No, citizens who pay income tax are not eligible to join APY.

schemes.scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (Maharashtra Mahadbt)
schemes.short_description: Post-matric educational tuition and maintenance allowance for OBC students in Maharashtra.
schemes.description: State scheme implemented by the Other Backward Bahujan Welfare Department, Government of Maharashtra. Reimburses tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance to eligible OBC students.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: OBC Post-Matric Students residing in Maharashtra
schemes.income_requirements: Annual family income up to Rs 1.00 Lakh (full scholarship) or up to Rs 8.00 Lakh (tuition fee waiver)
schemes.occupation_requirements: Student pursuing post-matric courses in Maharashtra

benefits.description: 100% Tuition Fee & Examination Fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 425 per month for day scholars / Rs 750 for hostellers.

root.description: Eligibility conditions for Maharashtra OBC Post Matric Scholarship.

conditions.description: Applicant must belong to OBC category and be a resident domicile of Maharashtra.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 1.00 Lakh for maintenance allowance and Rs 8.00 Lakh for fee waiver.
Admitted to recognized post-matric course in Maharashtra.

required_documents.name: OBC Caste Certificate issued by Maharashtra authority
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account

application_process.description: Visit mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in and click 'New Applicant Registration'.
Authenticate profile using Aadhaar OTP or biometric scan.
Fill personal, caste, income, domicile, and academic course details.
Select 'Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students' under VJNT, OBC and SBC Welfare Department.
Upload documents and submit to college for scrutinization.

faqs.question: What is the family income limit for OBC scholarship in Maharashtra?
faqs.answer: Up to Rs 1 Lakh for maintenance allowance; up to Rs 8 Lakh for tuition fee waiver.

faqs.question: Is Maharashtra domicile required?
faqs.answer: Yes, Maharashtra domicile certificate is mandatory.

schemes.short_description: Financial scholarship support for higher education students in Gujarat.
schemes.description: MYSY is a flagship Gujarat State government scheme providing financial assistance for tuition fees, hostel allowance, and book equipment grants to meritorious students pursuing Diploma, Bachelor's, and Professional degrees.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Students pursuing Higher Education in Gujarat
schemes.income_requirements: Annual family income up to Rs 6.00 Lakh per annum
schemes.occupation_requirements: Student with 80+ percentile in 10th/12th or 65+ percentile in Diploma

benefits.description: 50% tuition fee grant (up to Rs 2.00 Lakh/year for Medical/Dental, Rs 50,000 for Engineering), plus Rs 1,200/month hostel allowance and Rs 10,000 book/equipment grant.

conditions.description: Student must have secured 80 or more percentile in 10th/12th board exams or 65+ percentile in Diploma.
Annual family income must be less than or equal to Rs 6,00,000 per annum.
Must be a domicile resident of Gujarat State studying in recognized college.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate issued by Mamlatdar / TDO

application_process.description: Visit mysy.guj.nic.in and click 'Fresh Application'.
Register with board, passing year, seat number, and mobile number.
Fill personal, family income, and college course details.
Upload documents online and verify physical documents at designated Help Center.
Scholarship disbursed directly to student bank account.

faqs.question: What is the percentile criteria for MYSY?
faqs.answer: 80 or above percentile in Class 10/12, or 65+ percentile for Diploma students.

faqs.question: What is the family income limit for MYSY?
faqs.answer: Up to Rs 6 Lakh per annum.

schemes.short_description: Paid 12-month internships in top 500 companies for youth aged 21 to 24.
schemes.description: Under Ministry of Corporate Affairs / MY Bharat platform, PMIS offers young graduates and diploma holders hands-on corporate exposure with a monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 and one-time grant of Rs 6,000.
schemes.department: Department of Youth Affairs / Ministry of Corporate Affairs
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Youth aged 21 to 24 with Higher Secondary, ITI, Diploma, or BA/BSc/BCom degrees
schemes.income_requirements: Family income not exceeding Rs 8 Lakh per annum; no family member in government service

benefits.description: Monthly stipend of Rs 5,000 (Rs 4,500 from Govt + Rs 500 from Company CSR) for 12 months, plus one-time incidentals grant of Rs 6,000.

root.description: Eligibility criteria for PM Internship Scheme.

conditions.description: Applicant age must be between 21 and 24 years.
Educational qualification: Passed Higher Secondary (10+2), ITI, Diploma, or undergraduate degrees (BA, BSc, BCom, BBA, BCA, BPharma).
IIT, IIM, IISER, CA, CMA, CS, MBBS, BDS, MBA, Master's degree holders are NOT eligible.
Family income must be below Rs 8.00 Lakh per annum.

required_documents.name: Self-Declaration of Family Income (< Rs 8 Lakh)

application_process.description: Visit pminternship.mca.gov.in or mybharat.gov.in.
Register using mobile number and complete e-KYC using Aadhaar.
Fill educational details, skill preferences, and locations.
Select up to 5 internship options across participating companies.
Companies shortlist candidates and issue digital offer letter.

faqs.question: What is the monthly stipend for PM Internship Scheme?
faqs.answer: Rs 5,000 per month for 12 months, plus Rs 6,000 one-time grant.

faqs.question: Are post-graduates eligible?
faqs.answer: No, post-graduates and Master's degree holders are excluded.

schemes.short_description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,500 for eligible women in Maharashtra.
schemes.description: Flagship welfare initiative of the Government of Maharashtra providing direct cash transfers to women aged 21 to 65 years to foster financial independence, nutrition, and empowerment.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Married, Divorced, Widowed, and Single Women in Maharashtra
schemes.income_requirements: Annual family income up to Rs 2.50 Lakh (or Yellow/Orange Ration Card holders)

benefits.description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 1,500 transferred directly into beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT.

root.description: Eligibility criteria for Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana.

conditions.description: Woman applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra state aged 21 to 65 years.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2.50 Lakh.
No family member should be a permanent government employee or income tax payer.

required_documents.name: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or Ration Card / Voter ID issued in Maharashtra
Income Certificate / Orange or Yellow Ration Card

application_process.channel: Nari Shakti Doot App / Portal / Anganwadi
application_process.description: Apply via Nari Shakti Doot Mobile App, official portal, or visit Anganwadi / Setu Kendra.
Register mobile number and verify via OTP.
Enter Aadhaar details, address, family income, and bank account info.
Upload photograph, Aadhaar, ration card/domicile, and self-declaration.
After Anganwadi/Taluka scrutiny, monthly Rs 1,500 is credited via DBT.

faqs.question: How much money is given under Ladki Bahin Yojana?
faqs.answer: Rs 1,500 per month (Rs 18,000 annually).

faqs.question: What is the age limit?
faqs.answer: Women aged between 21 and 65 years.

schemes.short_description: End-to-end holistic support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades.
schemes.description: Central sector scheme providing recognition (PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID), skill upgrading, toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, and collateral-free credit support up to Rs 3 Lakh at 5% interest rate to traditional artisans.
schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Artisans and Craftsmen in 18 Traditional Trades (Carpenters, Blacksmiths, Goldsmiths, Potters, Tailors, Masons, etc.)
schemes.income_requirements: Traditional artisan families working with hands and tools
schemes.occupation_requirements: Engaged in one of 18 traditional family trades

benefits.description: Rs 15,000 Toolkit Incentive e-Voucher + Rs 500/day stipend during skill training + Collateral-free credit up to Rs 1 Lakh (1st tranche) and Rs 2 Lakh (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest rate.

conditions.description: Artisan working hands-on in one of the 18 eligible traditional trades.
Minimum age 18 years at registration.
Restricted to one member per family.

application_process.description: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
Perform Aadhaar biometric authentication.
Gram Panchayat / ULB verification, Nodal Officer scrutiny, and National Committee approval.
Download digital PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card.

faqs.question: What is the toolkit incentive amount?
faqs.answer: Rs 15,000 e-voucher for purchasing modern tools.

schemes.short_description: Free deposit-free LPG gas connection and Rs 300 subsidy per cylinder for poor women.
schemes.description: Aims to safeguard health of women and children by providing clean cooking fuel (LPG) to adult women of poor households who do not possess LPG connection.
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Adult Women from BPL / SC / ST / Most Backward Classes households
schemes.income_requirements: BPL Household / SECC 2011 list / Antyodaya Anna Yojana cardholders

benefits.description: Free LPG Connection (deposit waiver for cylinder & regulator) + first refill & stove free + Rs 300 targeted subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills per year.

conditions.description: Applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 years or above.
Belonging to SC/ST/PMAY/Antyodaya/Forest Dwellers/Most Backward Classes or BPL household.
No existing LPG connection in any household member's name.

application_process.description: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
Fill Ujjwala application and KYC form.
LPG company performs electronic de-duplication check.
LPG connection released free of cost with first cylinder refill.

faqs.question: What is the subsidy amount per cylinder?
faqs.answer: Rs 300 targeted subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder credited directly to bank account via DBT.

schemes.short_description: Financial incentive up to Rs 1,10,000 for girl children in Gujarat in 3 stages.
schemes.description: State welfare scheme of Gujarat Government to prevent female foeticide, promote girl child education, and prevent child marriage. Provides financial payouts at Class 1, Class 9, and age 21.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: First and second girl children born in Gujarat families
schemes.age_requirements: Newly born girl child up to 1 year of age for registration
schemes.income_requirements: Annual family income up to Rs 2.00 Lakh

benefits.description: Total Rs 1,10,000 financial support: Rs 4,000 on Class 1 admission, Rs 6,000 on Class 9 admission, and Rs 1,00,000 upon attaining 21 years of age.

root.description: Eligibility criteria for Vahali Dikri Yojana.

conditions.description: Girl child born in Gujarat state on or after August 2, 2019.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 2,00,000 per annum.
Applicable for up to first 2 girl children per family.

required_documents.name: Income Certificate issued by Mamlatdar / TDO

application_process.description: Obtain Vahali Dikri application form from Anganwadi worker or CDPO office.
Fill application form and attach birth certificate and income proof within 1 year of child's birth.
Verified by Child Development Project Officer (CDPO).
Installments credited to bank account at specified milestones.

faqs.question: What is the total amount given under Vahali Dikri Yojana?
faqs.answer: Rs 1,10,000 paid across 3 stages (Class 1, Class 9, and age 21).

schemes.scheme_name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana (Delhi)
schemes.short_description: Free competitive exam coaching & Rs 2,500 monthly stipend for SC/ST/OBC/EWS students in Delhi.
schemes.description: Government of NCT of Delhi provides free quality coaching for competitive exams (UPSC, NEET, JEE, GATE, Banking, SSC) at empanelled coaching institutes for meritorious SC, ST, OBC, and EWS category students.
schemes.target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, OBC, and EWS students residing in Delhi preparing for competitive exams
schemes.age_requirements: 10th/12th passed students preparing for competitive entrance exams
schemes.income_requirements: Annual family income up to Rs 8.00 Lakh
schemes.location_requirements: Domicile resident of NCT of Delhi

benefits.description: 100% free coaching fee paid directly to empanelled coaching institute plus Rs 2,500 per month stipend paid to student for books/travel.

root.description: Eligibility criteria for Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana.

conditions.description: Student must belong to SC, ST, OBC, or EWS category and be a resident of Delhi.
Passed Class 10 and Class 12 from schools in Delhi.
Annual family income must not exceed Rs 8.00 Lakh per annum.

required_documents.name: Delhi Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC) or EWS Certificate
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Department Delhi

application_process.description: Apply directly at empanelled coaching institute or e-District Delhi portal (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in).
Submit caste certificate, income proof, and marksheets for institute verification.
SC/ST/OBC Department approves candidate enrollment.
Monthly Rs 2,500 stipend credited directly to student bank account.

faqs.question: What is the monthly stipend under Jai Bhim Yojana?
faqs.answer: Rs 2,500 per month paid to students during the coaching period.

schemes.short_description: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 2,000 for women head of households in Karnataka.
schemes.description: Flagship guarantee scheme of Government of Karnataka providing Rs 2,000 per month financial aid directly to the woman head of house specified in Antyodaya, BPL, and APL ration cards.
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development
schemes.target_beneficiaries: Woman Head of Household in Karnataka
schemes.age_requirements: 18 years and above (Head of Family woman)
schemes.income_requirements: Woman or husband must not be an income-tax payer or GST return filer
schemes.occupation_requirements: Woman Head of Family listed on Ration Card

benefits.description: Monthly cash assistance of Rs 2,000 credited directly to beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT.

root.description: Eligibility conditions for Gruha Lakshmi Scheme.

conditions.description: Woman named as head of the family on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration card in Karnataka.
Neither the woman nor her husband should be an income tax payer or GST payer.

required_documents.name: Ration Card (BPL / APL / Antyodaya) showing woman as head of family

application_process.channel: Seva Sindhu Portal / Grama One / Karnataka One
application_process.description: Apply online via Seva Sindhu Guarantee portal or visit Grama One / Karnataka One center.
System fetches ration card details automatically using Ration Card number.
Perform biometric/OTP Aadhaar authentication for woman head and husband.
Monthly Rs 2,000 transferred via NPCI Aadhaar Payments Bridge to beneficiary bank account.

faqs.question: How much financial support is given under Gruha Lakshmi?
faqs.answer: Rs 2,000 per month (Rs 24,000 per year).
